subject: Invoice issuance authority & AP collection schedule — Brightlane
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Brightlane <tom@brightlane.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice issuance authority & AP collection schedule — Brightlane

Tom — quick follow on invoice delivery and remit changes before production billing starts next month. Two short questions we need to lock down: 

1) Delivery channel: does Brightlane want invoices posted to your portal (we can push via SFTP/API) or emailed as PDF attachments to AP? We can do both (portal + email copy) but need to know the authoritative channel for your AP team.

2) Remit / payment collection: if you want payments to a new remit account (bank change) we require an authorized signature approving the remit change. Can you confirm who in your org signs that? If a signed authorization is required we can accept a PDF scan or a DocuSign envelope.

Also: what's your standard payment term (Net 30/45/60)? We default to Net 30 but can align to your Net 45 if that's part of the contract.

Attached: RI_invoice_draft_000123.pdf — sample invoice layout we'll push.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm preferred delivery channel and AP email address.
- Provide PO number (if required) or AP contact for automated forwarding.
- If remit change is requested, send signed authorization (see template Marissa will share).

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RI_invoice_draft_000123.pdf (PDF, draft)
From: Tom Brightlane <tom@brightlane.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Brightlane AP <ap@brightlane.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice issuance authority & AP collection schedule — Brightlane

Thanks Naomi — good questions.

1) Delivery: Brightlane AP prefers emailed PDF copies to ap@brightlane.com as the primary accept channel. We are evaluating a portal but cannot onboard it this quarter. An emailed PDF + machine-readable line items in the body (or CSV attachment) is ideal.

2) Remit changes: our treasury team requires a signed remit-change authorization for any bank account updates. I (Tom) can sign for our SMB group. If you need a named signatory on the document, please address it to:

Tom Brightlane
Head of Finance — SMB
Brightlane Payments

Payment terms: Net 45 for this engagement.

I attached our PO for the first month (Brightlane_PO_4521.pdf). If you can send an invoice with PO 4521 and mark ap@brightlane.com as the recipient, that will let our AP queue it.

—Tom
Tom Brightlane
Brightlane Payments
ap@brightlane.com

Thanks Tom — helpful. Quick internal notes / plan: 

> On Sat, Jun 20, 2026 at 09:12 Tom Brightlane <tom@brightlane.com> wrote:
> > Brightlane AP prefers emailed PDF copies to ap@brightlane.com as the primary accept channel.
> > Our treasury team requires a signed remit-change authorization.

Naomi / Marissa — action items: 
- Confirm that Redwood can issue emailed PDF to ap@brightlane.com plus include machine-readable line items in the email body (we have a CSV option).
- Marissa: can you confirm whether we require a wet signature OR whether a DocuSign signature suffices for a bank remit update? The customer sign-off needs to be to the named signatory Tom provided.
- Naomi: set invoice terms to Net 45 for Brightlane and include PO 4521 on the first invoice.

We can automate forwarding the invoice PDF to ap@brightlane.com from our billing system once we get confirmation on the authorization format. If they prefer portal later, we can re-route to SFTP/API.

Connor
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 11:04:00 -0700

Tom — thanks, confirmed. We require an authorized signature for any remit/account change. DocuSign is acceptable; a scanned signed PDF is also fine as long as it contains the signatory name, title, and date. 

I attached a short authorization template (signed_authorization_template.pdf) — please have the signatory (Tom Brightlane, Head of Finance — SMB) sign and return. Once we have that, we will: 

- Update the remit account on the account record (internal control step).
- Send the first invoice to ap@brightlane.com with PO 4521 and mark Net 45.
- Enable automated forwarding so future invoices are sent to AP as PDF and a copy stored in your portal (read-only) for audit.

If you want, I can open a DocuSign envelope and pre-populate the template to speed this up — let me know and I will send the link. Otherwise upload the signed PDF to the Doc link below or reply with the attachment.

Doc link: https://docusign.example.com/embedded/abc123

Next steps checklist: 
- Tom: sign and return signed_authorization_template.pdf (DocuSign OK).
- Naomi: send invoice #000123 with PO 4521 to ap@brightlane.com (Net 45) after we get the signed auth.
- Connor: enable auto-forward and confirm logging retention for AP copies.

Marissa Cole
Manager, Billing Compliance
Redwood Inference
